text:
maya: Quick copy pass on the Autoscale empty state in Console. Current headline: "No autoscale rules set" — I think it's a bit passive. Suggest: "Autoscaling isn't configured yet" and change primary CTA from "Create rule" to "Set up autoscaling". Reason: clearer for new users + matches other flows.

luke: +1 to clearer phrasing. "Set up autoscaling" is fine, but longer. Are we okay with CTA lengths? button width tight on mobile.

alex: Heads up: UI button max is 18 chars on mobile. "Set up autoscale" is 16, "Set up autoscaling" is 20. If we need shorter: "Enable autoscale" (15) or "Turn on autoscale" (16).

nina: A11y note: screen reader should announce context. For the CTA, consider aria-label="Set up autoscaling for this pool" if we shorten visual text. Also avoid punctuation-only tooltips — they read oddly.

sam: Product context: we want to encourage setup, but not sound forceful. Prefer verbs like "Enable" vs "Set up"? Which converts better? Jessica from growth (cc @jess) had a hypothesis that "Enable autoscale" converts higher.

jess: @sam @maya Growth tested similar CTAs on billing — "Enable" performed slightly better. But wording needs to match the funnel. Happy to run an A/B if engineering can support.

maya: OK options to pick:

- Visual headline: "Autoscaling isn't configured yet"
- Primary CTA candidates: `Enable autoscale`, `Set up autoscale`, `Turn on autoscale`
- Secondary text: "Reduce latency and cost by letting Redwood scale this pool automatically."

alex: Also consider tooltip copy for the info icon. Two variants below:

```
Variant A: "Autoscaling will add or remove instances automatically based on traffic. Configure rules to control min/max capacity."
Variant B (short): "Automatically scale GPU capacity by configuring autoscale rules."
```

nina: Variant B better for screen reader brevity. If you keep A, split into two sentences and ensure role="note" for the longer explanation.

luke: Tiny nit: change "GPU capacity" to "pool capacity" — some customers use CPU pools too in Dedicated. Keep generic.

maya: Updated copy with that change:

Headline: "Autoscaling isn't configured yet"
CTA (primary): "Enable autoscale"
Tooltip (short): "Automatically scale pool capacity by configuring autoscale rules."
Secondary blurb: "Reduce latency and cost by letting Redwood scale this pool automatically."

jess: LGTM. Can we make the secondary blurb 1 sentence and remove "automatically" duplicate? Maybe: "Reduce latency and cost by letting Redwood manage pool capacity." Small clarity win.

nina: Approve with small aria tweak: add aria-describedby pointing to the tooltip id so SR users get the short tooltip read when focused.

alex: I'll check button width on mobile with "Enable autoscale" and file a tiny CSS tweak if needed.

maya: Thanks all — I'll push these changes to Figma and update the PR description. Will tag for the next design review. :+1:
